question: Post-independence, India adopted a planned approach to build a mixed economy. Which sector was given top priority under the First Five-Year Plan?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Agriculture**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Post-independence**, India adopted a planned economic strategy to ensure balanced growth across different sectors.
 
• The **First Five-Year Plan** (1951–1956) was primarily focused on **agriculture** as India faced food shortages and low agricultural productivity.
 
• The plan prioritized increasing agricultural production to achieve **self-sufficiency** in food grains and reduce dependency
